title: Splice it right: the role of PRP21 in regulating seed germination responses to ABA
content: Seed germination is a crucial stage in the life cycle of plants that significantly impacts crop productivity and yield. During this vulnerable stage, plants are highly susceptible to various stress conditions, which can lead to substantial losses in crop production. Various abiotic stress conditions, such as drought, heat, and salinity, affect the seed germination stage, significantly affecting plant life as well as productivity.
